title: 42.22.2 STABLE Released
raw:
[h3]Updating your game client and previous, unmodded saves[/h3][p]By default your Steam client will automatically update to the latest version of the game, build 42.22.[/p][p]We work to ensure that previous save games can be continued in new versions, and for a completely un-modded, "vanilla" version of the game, your save game should work fine.[/p][p]After updating, when you launch the game and select 'Continue' or 'Load', you will be asked to 'convert' your save for the new update. Once you click yes, a backup of your existing save is created in the same folder with '_backup' added to the file name. This means if you do have any problems, you have a backup automatically available.[/p][p]If you have any issues with your [b]un-modded, vanilla [/b]save, please post to [url="https://theindiestone.com/forums/forum/18-pz-support/"]our forums[/url]. Please note we cannot provide technical support for modded saves.[/p][h3]Modded saves and 42.21 temporary branch[/h3][p]If your existing save game uses mods, it's possible that some mods may not work with the latest build. We would still recommend converting your save and seeing if your mods work, as you'll have the automatic backup available if you have issues. You can also manually backup your save by copying it.[/p][p]If you wish to continue to wait until mod creators update mods that you use frequently, you can continue to play on build 42.21.[/p][p]In your Steam Library, right click the entry for Project Zomboid and click 'Properties', then select 'Game Versions & Betas' and select '42.21' from the list. This will automatically update your client back to version 42.21 and your save / mods should work.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4460946/a0ca6406e9199f1e1b2867035c10e79ea235a4a4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]NEW[/h1][list][*][p]     Added ladder support
[/p][/*][*][p]     Added crowbar mechanic to force locked doors and windows
[/p][/*][*][p]     Players will have the option to sleep disabled, with an explanatory tooltip, when subjected to an active Bad Smell moodle.
[/p][/*][*][p]     Player-crafted makeshift radios no longer have randomized encumbrance values and instead use the encumbrance value of their corresponding tiles. To make the makeshift walkie talkie inventory item value match that of the tile, it’s encumbrance value has been changed to 5.
[/p][/*][*][p]     Raccoon skulls can be used as inputs for appropriate animal skull necklace craftRecipes.
[/p][/*][*][p]     Implemented Texture Swapping for Handheld Lightsources
[/p][/*][*][p]     Player drops items when hand-to-hand-- If holding two heavy items, the primary is dropped.-- If holding a flashlight and a heavy item, the primary item is dropped.-- If holding two flashlights, the primary is dropped.
[/p][/*][*][p]     Updated localization
[/p][/*][*][p]     New sound effects for equipping/unequipping weapons/throwables, and ladder footsteps. Dozens of new variations here for subtle immersion improvements.
